project.title: Periphyton metagenomes from wastewater-effluent receiving streams in Switzerland
project.description: Periphyton metagenomes from wastewater-effluent receiving streams in Switzerland. Sampling was conducted at multiple sites upstream and downstream of wastewater treatment plants as well as wastewater influent and effluent for comparison.
project.center_name: Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology
